name: Ravine Despoiler
author: Ben Combee (@unwiredben); Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors
license: Apache-2.0 (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)
description: Ravine Despoiler by Ben Combee: fly over the ravine and drop bombs on the boulders below, in the spirit of an Atari arcade classic. A missed shot costs five points.

descriptions.it: Ravine Despoiler di Ben Combee: sorvola il burrone e sgancia bombe sui massi sottostanti, nello spirito di un classico arcade Atari. Un colpo a vuoto costa cinque punti.
